borrow_debt_present.meaning: the Portfolio Margin account holds USDC borrow debt against eligible collateral

supplied_collateral_present.meaning: principal is bridged to HyperCore and held in Portfolio Margin supplied positions

borrow_debt_socialized_to_usdm_holders.meaning: the ignored Portfolio Margin borrow debt is effectively socialized to USDM holders while the false surplus is distributed as yield

assumptions: Borrow debt and supplied collateral coexist in the Portfolio Margin account before yield bridging and settlement.
The reported backing/surplus computation is the one used by bridgeYieldFromL1(), settle(), and distributeYield().

unresolved.description: Report does not quantify borrow debt, false surplus, or the resulting undercollateralization, so the netting relation is represented only by the report-stated qualitative socialization outcome.
Report does not state who triggers the borrow or whether it is attacker-controlled versus a normal vault operation.

limitations: The selected impact is formalized as the absence of borrow-debt socialization to USDM holders; exact numeric netting of borrow against backing is not quantified in the report.
Other impacts such as usdm_undercollateralized are not covered by this plan.
